title: T-GRAB: A Synthetic Diagnostic Benchmark for Learning on Temporal Graphs
venue: MLoG-GenAI Workshop at KDD 2025; arXiv v2
relevance: Direct project predecessor: periodic counting, delayed causal and long-range graph tasks.
novelty_threat: A new periodic graph benchmark or GC-LSTM periodicity observation is already covered.
limitations: Next-graph performance does not establish independently cued memory loss.

title: On Vanishing Gradients, Over-Smoothing, and Over-Squashing in GNNs: Bridging Recurrent and Graph Learning
relevance: Connects graph propagation, recurrent models, Jacobian contraction and feature collapse.
novelty_threat: A general Jacobian explanation of graph collapse is already explicit prior work.
limitations: Depth, common-zero-map and contraction assumptions differ from input-forced temporal memory.

title: Persistent Gaussian Perturbations Prevent Oversmoothing in Recurrent Graph Neural Networks
relevance: Persistent additive Gaussian perturbations sustain nonzero stationary graph Dirichlet energy.
novelty_threat: Noise-maintained geometric diversity under contraction is not a new theorem direction.
limitations: The stated guarantee is geometric; it explicitly does not establish downstream memory or accuracy.

title: Graph Neural Networks Exponentially Lose Expressive Power for Node Classification
relevance: Spectral sufficient conditions yield asymptotic information loss in deep GCNs.
novelty_threat: Dynamical explanations of repeated graph propagation are established.
evidence_locator: Primary arXiv abstract; ICLR proceedings PDF located
limitations: Static graph depth and norm conditions; not a blanket theorem about trained temporal models.

title: Demystifying Oversmoothing in Attention-Based Graph Neural Networks
relevance: Time-varying nonlinear graph attention is analysed with matrix products and joint spectral radius.
novelty_threat: Time-varying attention propagation and exponential oversmoothing already have theory.
limitations: Requires paper-specific mixing and boundedness assumptions; state axis differs from cue-conditioned memory.

title: Rank Collapse Causes Over-Smoothing and Over-Correlation in Graph Neural Networks
venue: Proceedings of the Second Learning on Graphs Conference, PMLR 231
relevance: Rank collapse unifies graph oversmoothing and feature over-correlation.
novelty_threat: Using rank instead of node similarity alone is established.
limitations: Results concern graph propagation operators, not arbitrary nonlinear recurrent states.

title: Preventing Representational Rank Collapse in MPNNs by Splitting the Computational Graph
relevance: Multi-relational message passing is designed to preserve independent representation directions.
novelty_threat: Anti-collapse graph architectural interventions already exist.
limitations: An architecture intervention does not isolate temporal periodic forcing.

title: Graph-Coupled Oscillator Networks
relevance: Oscillator-based graph propagation links oversmoothing to stability of homogeneous states.
novelty_threat: Oscillatory dynamics as an anti-oversmoothing mechanism are prior art.
limitations: Continuous-depth oscillator mechanism is distinct from forced periodic memory.

title: TGB-Seq Benchmark: Challenging Temporal GNNs with Complex Sequential Dynamics
venue: arXiv preprint; publication venue not independently checked
relevance: Sequential temporal graph benchmark reduces easy edge-repeatability shortcuts.
novelty_threat: Long-history evaluation and repetition confounds have benchmark precedents.
limitations: Natural sequential prediction differs from controlled cue retention.

title: Long Range Propagation on Continuous-Time Dynamic Graphs
relevance: Continuous-time dynamic graph models seek long-range propagation.
novelty_threat: Long-term temporal graph memory is an established architectural objective.
limitations: Architectural context; no verified anticipation of the exact matched-body experiment.

title: GC-LSTM: Graph Convolution Embedded LSTM for Dynamic Link Prediction
relevance: Graph-convolution embedded LSTM used in the inherited preliminary experiments.
novelty_threat: Baseline architecture, not a new contribution of this project.
evidence_locator: Primary arXiv abstract and journal reference
limitations: Publication year is journal year; analyse all node hidden and cell state.

title: T-GCN: A Temporal Graph Convolutional Network for Traffic Prediction
venue: IEEE Transactions on Intelligent Transportation Systems
relevance: Temporal graph convolution combined with gated recurrence for traffic prediction.
novelty_threat: Established modality-native recurrent baseline.
limitations: Need actual implementation state contract before dynamical comparison.

title: EvolveGCN: Evolving Graph Convolutional Networks for Dynamic Graphs
relevance: Recurrent evolution of graph convolution parameters.
novelty_threat: Established model family; evolving weights belong in the persistent state.
limitations: State is not interchangeable with node-level hidden activations.

title: Diffusion Convolutional Recurrent Neural Network: Data-Driven Traffic Forecasting
relevance: Diffusion graph convolution and recurrent forecasting for road sensors.
novelty_threat: Native traffic recurrence baseline and METR-LA provenance.
limitations: Forecasting success does not certify arbitrary-cue retention.

title: Temporal Graph Networks for Deep Learning on Dynamic Graphs
relevance: Event-based temporal graph memory and message updates.
novelty_threat: Explicit graph memory is longstanding; relevant comparison to snapshot recurrence.
limitations: Event timestamps, stored messages and update chronology affect state completeness.

title: Convolutional LSTM Network: A Machine Learning Approach for Precipitation Nowcasting
relevance: Convolutional input and recurrent transitions support spatiotemporal forecasting.
novelty_threat: Established modality-native recurrent baseline.
limitations: Baseline reference; no claim of demonstrated repetition-induced collapse.

title: Delving Deeper into Convolutional Networks for Learning Video Representations
relevance: Convolutional GRU feature processing for video representations.
novelty_threat: Established convolutional gated recurrence.
limitations: Visual encoder and spatial state create additional comparison factors.

title: Prevalence of Neural Collapse during the terminal phase of deep learning training
venue: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
relevance: Terminal training exhibits class-conditioned neural-collapse geometry.
novelty_threat: The phrase neural collapse has a precise existing supervised-learning meaning.
evidence_locator: Primary abstract and PMC article record
limitations: Training-phase class geometry is not fixed-weight repetition-induced forgetting.

title: Understanding Dimensional Collapse in Contrastive Self-supervised Learning
relevance: Dimensional collapse in contrastive self-supervised learning.
novelty_threat: Dimension collapse is established terminology and objective-dependent phenomenon.
limitations: Training objectives and data augmentations differ from inference dynamics.

title: Finding structure with randomness: Probabilistic algorithms for constructing approximate matrix decompositions
relevance: Randomized methods approximate dominant matrix decompositions.
novelty_threat: Matrix-free spectral estimation is an implementation tool, not scientific novelty here.
evidence_locator: Primary arXiv abstract and Caltech publication record
limitations: Partial decompositions require residual and tail checks.

title: Hutch++: Optimal Stochastic Trace Estimation
relevance: Variance-reduced stochastic trace estimation for PSD operators.
novelty_threat: Scalable trace-based effective dimensions build on established estimators.
evidence_locator: Primary arXiv abstract and PMC publication record
limitations: Ratios of estimated traces need uncertainty analysis.

title: Sur les équations différentielles linéaires à coefficients périodiques
venue: Annales scientifiques de l’École Normale Supérieure
relevance: Original continuous-time periodic linear-system foundation.
novelty_threat: Floquet analysis itself is classical; applying a period map needs a distinct scientific question.
limitations: Historical source; the project uses discrete updates, and no claim is made to have audited this French proof.

title: The Effective Rank: a Measure of Effective Dimensionality
relevance: Entropy-based effective rank provides a historical measurement reference.
novelty_threat: Normalized spectral dimension is an established diagnostic, not an information-retention theorem.
limitations: Repository DOI; distinguish normalized singular-value entropy from covariance-eigenvalue entropy.

title: A theory of multineuronal dimensionality, dynamics and measurement
relevance: Task complexity and trajectory smoothness constrain observed neural dimension.
novelty_threat: Dimension changing with task or temporal sampling is not by itself a novel recurrent-memory result.
evidence_locator: Main introduction and theory overview; Supplement II.II participation-ratio definition.
limitations: Selected sections only; trial-averaged neural activity and sampling theory differ from conditioned cue retention.

title: Dimensionality in recurrent spiking networks: Global trends in activity and local origins in connectivity
relevance: Relates recurrent connectivity and external input to covariance dimensionality.
novelty_threat: Generic recurrence-to-dimension mechanisms have substantial neuroscience antecedents.
evidence_locator: Introduction and Results dimensionality definitions/connectivity expansion.
limitations: Selected sections; spiking/Hawkes and linearized population models do not directly prove useful-history loss in trained gated networks.

title: Strong and localized recurrence controls the dimensionality of neural activity across brain areas
relevance: Recent biological recurrence-dimensionality comparison across brain areas.
novelty_threat: Broad recurrence controls dimension framing is already active and needs acknowledgment.
evidence_locator: Publisher/PubMed abstract and Crossref metadata; online 2026-08-19.
limitations: No audited proof or trained-AI memory result; publisher access can be restricted.
version_note: Author-hosted 34-page manuscript dated 2026-08-13, labelled Nature Neuroscience submission; metadata refers to published article 2026-08-19. Not the publisher typeset PDF.

title: The Graph Neural Network Model
relevance: Early graph-state recurrence and contraction-based computation.
novelty_threat: Treating GNN computation as recurrent state dynamics is foundational prior art.
limitations: Historical graph-state architecture, not a periodic temporal-graph cue-retention experiment.

title: PredRNN: Recurrent Neural Networks for Predictive Learning using Spatiotemporal LSTMs
venue: Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems 30
relevance: Native video-prediction baseline with temporal and spatial memory paths.
novelty_threat: Architecture coverage is replication scope; adapter must include both memories.
evidence_locator: Official NeurIPS abstract and author list.
limitations: No claim about periodicity-specific collapse in this source.
